description: Lesson a4: FreeRTOS V11.1.0 (GCC/ARM_CM3 port, clang) — tasks fast (prio 3, 100 ms) and blink (prio 2, 250 ms, PA5 LED) send to a queue, a logger task (prio 1) prints every message and 1 s statistics; PB12 EXTI -> xQueueSendFromISR
expect:
72 MHz, FreeRTOS-Kernel V11.1.0 (port GCC/ARM_CM3, heap_4 8 KiB, tick 1 kHz on SysTick shared with HAL_IncTick; SVC starts the first task, PendSV switches context, SysTick/PendSV at priority 15, configMAX_SYSCALL_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY 5). USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1, written only by the logger task. Boot: 'FreeRTOS V11.1.0 on STM32F103C8, 72 MHz, tick 1000 Hz ', 'tasks: fast prio 3 every 100 ms, blink prio 2 every 250 ms, logger prio 1; queue 8 x 8 B ', 'heap free 5192 B, starting the scheduler ' (the pending SysTick left over from the BASEPRI-masked boot is cleared, so tick 0 = scheduler start, about 16.7 ms after the first byte). Task fast (vTaskDelayUntil 100 ms) sends {seq, tick}; task blink (vTaskDelayUntil 250 ms) toggles PA5 (LED on at 250 ms, 2 Hz square wave) and sends {seq, level, tick}; the logger (lowest priority, blocked on the 8-entry queue) prints '[] fast #' about 0.1 ms after each tick 100*n, '[] blink # LED on|off' 0.19 ms (odd n) or 1.94 ms (even n, after the fast line of the same tick) after the PA5 edge, and after every 4th blink line '[] stats: context switches, idle %, queue peak

/8, stack free fast blink logger words' (S = changes of the running task in the last second, 38 without button presses; I = idle task share of DWT->CYCCNT from the kernel run-time statistics, about 96-97 %). PB12 (pull-up, EXTI falling, NVIC priority 6): a falling edge at least 50 ms after the previously accepted one sends {seq, tick} by xQueueSendFromISR + portYIELD_FROM_ISR -> '[] button # (EXTI ISR -> queue)' about 0.2 ms later. Experiments read at reset: PB13 tied to GND creates task hog (prio 4) that busy-loops from 1000 ms on — every other task starves, the output stops after the 900 ms line and PA5 stops toggling; PB14 tied to GND gives EXTI15_10 NVIC priority 2 (above the syscall limit) — the first press ends in 'configASSERT failed: port.c:805' (vPortValidateInterruptPriority) and the core stops with interrupts disabled.

circuit: PA5: red LED + 220 ohm to GND
PB13: open (the hog-task experiment jumper to GND is not placed)
PB14: open (the bad-interrupt-priority experiment jumper to GND is not placed)
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

boot.USART1:
FreeRTOS V11.1.0 on STM32F103C8, 72 MHz, tick 1000 Hz
tasks: fast prio 3 every 100 ms, blink prio 2 every 250 ms, logger prio 1; queue 8 x 8 B
heap free 5192 B, starting the scheduler

signals.match: ^\[ +\d+\] stats: (?:3[0-9]|4[0-6]) context switches, idle 9[0-9]\.\d%, queue peak [1-3]/8, stack free fast \d+ blink \d+ logger \d+ words\r\n$

scenarios.name: a button press: EXTI ISR -> xQueueSendFromISR -> the logger prints it
contact bounce inside the 50 ms lock-out counts once
